87582: Hakuya's younger sister, who somehow manages to enroll in Kobeni's class. She often tries to vocalize that she isn't a child, but her honest feelings over her likes and dislikes are often read easily by the others.
87583: Hakuya is Kobeni Yonomori's fiancé who suddenly appears on her 16th birthday with his little sister Mashiro Mitsumine. He and his sister start living in the same house as Kobeni and her own sister, Benio Yonomori.
87584: The main heroine, a responsible sixteen-year-old who handles cooking and chores well. On her 16th birthday, a young man named Hakuya and Mashiro suddenly appear in front of her, in which it turns out that Hakuya is her fiancé and Mashiro is her future sister-in-law.
88065: She is the student council secretary. She idolizes Benio due to how nice Benio was towards her when she first moved into town. As a result, she studied hard to get into the same school, and managed to work her way into the student council to be near Benio.
88066: She is a member of the school's newspaper club, she is very nosy and often spies on ones personal affairs just to make a story.
88069: The student council vice president. She is much more refined and mature than Benio (who is the student council president). She is always the one who keeps Benio in-check whenever she is getting out of control.
